newsitem.title: USA: CME HOGS SEEN STEADY TO LOWER, PORK BELLIES MIXED.
newsitem.headline: CME HOGS SEEN STEADY TO LOWER, PORK BELLIES MIXED.

text.p: CME hog futures were expected to open steady to 0.150 cent per lb lower while calls on pork belly futures ranged mixed, from 0.100 cent higher to 0.200 lower, livestock analysts said.

Lower cash hog indications and lower pork cutout values were expected to spark selling in hog futures. The weak fundamentals were seen adding pressure from a bearish chart picture which showed hog futures at lowest levels in two weeks, analysts said.
Seasonal considerations will also pressure the market as hog prices usually retreat this time of year into early September, some sources said.
